variants.style: Topographic / cartographic: contour lines, map legends, coordinates as decoration
variants.typography: Grotesk sans for everything, extreme size contrast
variants.motion: Hover-centric: rich hover and focus states, static otherwise
variants.wildcard: Use the testimonials as a dominant visual element

agentSummary: This week's portfolio design strictly follows a topographic and cartographic aesthetic, utilizing a midnight purple and acid green color palette. The layout employs a 12-column asymmetric magazine spread that features extreme typographic size contrast, relying on default grotesk sans-serif fonts to pass stringent Content Security Policy checks. Deep hover states provide rich interactive feedback while preserving a motion-free static default, fulfilling the hover-centric requirement. Crucially, the wildcard constraint is met by intertwining massive, screen-spanning testimonial quotes as structural interstitial elements throughout the page. All hard constraints, including strict data provenance and fully responsive accessibility requirements, have been successfully validated.
